sentences.text: 2  W THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE VENKATESWARLU NIMMAGADDA
WRIT PETITION NO: 11505/2025  ORDER:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of the India seeking the following reliefs:-
"to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declare the action of Respondent No. 3 and his staff trying to dispossess the petitioners from the agricultural land measuring an extent of Ac.0.63 cents in Sy.No. 119/6 of Karur Village, Tada Mandal, Tirupatl District, without issuing notification under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for acquiring the land of the petitioner as illegal, arbitrary and in violation of Article 14,
21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and consequently direct the respondent No.
4 not to interfere and dispossess the petitioners from the agricultural land measuring an extent of Ac.0.63 cents in Sy.No.119/6 of Karur Village, Tada Mandal, Tirupati District and pass such other order. "
2. During hearing, learned counsel for the petitioners, without touching the merits of the case,
requested this Court to issue a direction to the respondents not to interfere and dispossess the petitioner from the subject property without following due process of law.
\ 3, Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Revenue furnished the written instructions issued by the 4"" respondent dated 05.05.2025, wherein it is stated as follows;
"The subject land not related to petitioner Nos. 1 and 2.
There is no provision of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
